About This Auction

PROPERTY: 76.8 +/- Acres in Butler County, Kansas near Towanda AUCTION DATE: August 22nd, 2024 at 6 PM Central AUCTION LOCATION: Hidden Cedars Venue at 16317 SW 10th St, Benton, KS 67017 On behalf of the Tingle Trust, L2 Realty introduces an exceptional opportunity to invest in high-quality tillable farm ground in Butler County. Near the Towanda and Benton communities, this tract of land encompasses approximately 76.8 +/- acres. This auction presents an excellent land investment opportunity close to the Wichita Metro. Soils on the tract include 13% Class 1 Norge silt loam, 42% Class 2 Ladysmith silty clay loam, and 45% Class 2 Irwin silty clay loam. Commonly grown crops include corn, soybeans, milo, and wheat. The tillable ground is currently under a 40/60 crop share arrangement. Possession will occur this fall after harvest of the 2024 summer crop.  Half a mile of road frontage on SW Parallel St and a quarter mile of frontage on NW Santa Fe Lake Rd creates ample access to the property. The large amount of frontage also lends itself to potential development of rural home sites in the future. The property is set to be auctioned off on August 22nd, 2024 at the Hidden Cedars Venue near Benton at 6 PM CST. Contact us now for more information and to participate in this exciting auction event. Bidding will occur online and in-person the evening of the auction. Join us at the venue to discuss local real estate and enjoy some refreshments! Please call or email the listing agent, Tyler Gentry, at (316) 641-3173 or tgentry@L2realtyinc.com to set up your private showing of this property!
